outcome: Diagnosis of placental implantation-related diseases (confirmed by surgical pathology or clinical follow-up)
cohort: Seventy pregnant women with suspected placental implantation and placenta previa (mean age 28.5 +/- 4.2 years, mean parity 3.0 +/- 1.1).
finding: Obstetric ultrasound demonstrated high diagnostic performance for placental implantation, achieving 86.0% sensitivity, 72.0% specificity, 84.1% positive predictive value, and 75.0% negative predictive value.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, between August 2022 and August 2024
